phases.objective: Expose a Staging-only path-scoped OAuth issuer for the exact WordPress mad4b-read resource without changing the primary Remote MCP resource or Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: RFC 8414 discovery followed by DCR, PKCE authorization code, token exchange, refresh, and JWKS verification
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The client receives only resource-bound RS256 mad4b-read access while the WordPress resource server needs no private signing authority.
steps: Discover the dedicated path-scoped Staging authorization server and public JWKS.
Register an allowlisted ChatGPT callback without enabling DCR on the primary MCP issuer.
Authorize the exact WordPress mad4b-read resource with PKCE S256 and explicit consent.
Exchange the single-use code for an RS256 access token and opaque refresh token.
Verify issuer, audience, resource, scope, kid and RSA signature using only the public JWK.
assertions: The access token is RS256 and cannot be validated by the primary HS256 OAuth signing secret.
The exact WordPress resource is the JWT audience and resource claim.
mad4b:write and alternate resources fail closed.
Primary Remote MCP DCR remains disabled when only the WordPress Staging DCR switch is enabled.
No Production or mutation authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Persist the dedicated RSA signing key across Staging container restarts and support refresh-token continuity with offline_access while preserving resource isolation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Staging container startup followed by OAuth authorization and refresh
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A persistent 3072-bit RSA key is generated once under the Staging data volume, restart preserves it, and refresh rotation remains bound to the exact WordPress resource.
steps: Generate the private RSA key only when the Staging-only OAuth federation is enabled and no key exists.
Persist the key under the mounted /app/data OAuth directory with private file permissions.
Validate and reuse the same key on subsequent startup rather than rotating implicitly.
Advertise offline_access plus refresh_token support without granting any mutation scope.
Rotate refresh tokens and reject replay while retaining exact resource and read scope binding.
assertions: The private key never enters Git, the image, WordPress, JWKS, logs or tool output.
The public JWKS contains standard RSA n/e material and no x5c requirement.
Refresh succeeds without requiring the client to resend resource and cannot move to another resource.
offline_access is a refresh capability only and does not imply write authority.

phases.objective: Exercise external dependency faults, signing-key recovery and refresh races against the real Staging ingress.
Complete the real ChatGPT to WordPress Staging OAuth handshake and MCP tool scan.
blockers: Requires deployment of the exact PR head to the local Staging runtime and exact WordPress candidate package.
Requires a real external ChatGPT OAuth session and subject-bridge readback.

phases.objective: Production federation is explicitly outside this change and remains separately gated.
